name: verify
detail: Every check is a property this project claims somewhere in prose. A guarantee nobody can run is a guarantee nobody should believe.

checks.name: AtRiskRecord stays V2-generic
checks.detail: no payment-specific fields; V2 adds a leak_type, not a migration

checks.name: money is integer paise
checks.detail: no float touches money

checks.name: idempotency key is UNIQUE at the database
checks.detail: UNIQUE(idempotency_key) — double execution is impossible

checks.name: audit_log is append-only at the database
checks.detail: UPDATE and DELETE triggers present

checks.name: batch is reproducible from seed
checks.detail: seed 42 -> 180 records, 1120981400 paise, digest 2506edd429e9728e, amounts AND timestamps identical every run

checks.name: detectors cover all V1 leak types
checks.detail: abandoned_carts, failed_mandates, failed_payments, overdue_invoices

checks.name: every leak type has a detector
checks.detail: 4 detectors cover all 4 leak types

checks.name: outcome simulator covers every RootCause
checks.detail: all 17 causes have a success probability

checks.name: deterministic map yields valid causes
checks.detail: 37 error codes mapped

checks.name: deterministic map matches harvested Razorpay codes
checks.detail: all 2 harvested reasons are mapped or explicitly ambiguous

checks.name: policies.yaml covers every reachable cause
checks.detail: 24 reachable combinations, all with a row and an UNKNOWN fallback

checks.name: 14 guardrails implemented and registered
checks.detail: confidence_floor, consent, cooldown, daily_budget, dnd, frequency_cap, freshness, idempotency, kill_switch, max_attempts, promise_window, quiet_hours, state_validity, value_ceiling

checks.name: webhook signature verifies raw bytes
checks.detail: raw-byte HMAC; re-serialized, unsigned and unkeyed bodies all refused

checks.name: webhook handles the five outcome events
checks.detail: order.paid, payment.captured, payment.failed, payment_link.paid, subscription.charged

checks.name: API exposes every documented route
checks.detail: 7 required routes present

checks.name: no action executed twice
